name: Guardian AI: Deepfake Voice Shield
description: Browser-based audio review for user-uploaded or user-recorded samples. Provides Gemini-assisted synthetic-speech screening with clear limitations; it does not intercept cellular calls or verify a speaker's identity.
majorCapabilities: User-initiated browser microphone recording and audio upload
Firebase Google sign-in and user-owned Firestore history
Server-side Gemini-assisted audio screening with cautious result explanations
